candidate_name: Liberia gas-to-power LNG supply (Genser Energy 270 MW proposal)
sponsor_or_proposer: Genser Energy (IPP, in discussions with the Liberian government); backed in principle by utility LEC and WAPP's Transco CLSG.
current_state: Government-level discussions and site visits for a greenfield ~270 MW gas-fired plant, Liberia's first. Liberia has no domestic gas or pipeline supply, so fuel would have to arrive as LNG by sea, but no LNG import terminal/FSU has been proposed, no site fixed, no PPA or FID. Separately, a West-African small-scale LNG ecosystem concept (FSU + onshore regas serving mining demand in Guinea/Sierra Leone/Liberia/Ghana, with satellite storage mooted at Buchanan and Monrovia) exists only as consultancy/expert commentary.
missing_threshold_elements: No LNG terminal component announced (the tracked asset would be the import facility, not the power plant); no site; no concrete step (discussions only); fuel-supply chain unspecified.
watch_for: Genser (or another sponsor) announcing an LNG import solution - FSU/FSRU charter, jetty or storage site at Monrovia/Buchanan; a PPA or IPP licence naming LNG; DFI (World Bank/IFC/AfDB/DFC) appraisal of a Liberia LNG import facility. Promote to new_terminals when a marine LNG import facility with a sponsor + site + concrete step appears.
